    SELECT DISTINCT

        TRY_CAST(

    SELECT 
        pid,
        year_num,
        year_num - LAG(year_num) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY year_num) as gap
    FROM actor_years
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) as total_in_gaps FROM actor_gaps
